info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Intellectual Property Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Intellectual Property Portfolio Management API provides businesses with the capability to effectively manage their intellectual property assets. By using this API, organizations can submit new intellectual property entries, including patents and trademarks, to enhance their portfolio management strategies. Typical consumers of this API include legal teams, IP managers, and product developers who require streamlined processes for IP asset management. This API ensures that businesses maintain a well-organized inventory of their intellectual assets, fostering innovation and competitive advantage.

post.summary: Create a new intellectual property portfolio.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new intellectual property portfolio, adding key assets that contribute to their overall knowledge management strategy. Provide the necessary details in the request body to establish the portfolio successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update an intellectual property portfolio within the knowledge assets. It should include all relevant details regarding the assets to be managed, such as descriptions, categories, and associated metadata.

201.description: The intellectual property portfolio has been successfully created.
